hello.Text: [stand-in] Remi Gallois, weapons engineer. Always looking for field testers.

Text: [stand-in] I built an Experimental Hellfyre Rocket Launcher and it needs a live field test. The SANDSTORM Marauders camped east of here, out past the fence, will do nicely.
{delay 1}[stand-in] Take out three of them with it and come back. The ICC pays the bounty on them.
{delay 1}[stand-in] It is registered to my ID, so do not lose it.{close}

busy.Text: [stand-in] Three SANDSTORM Marauders, east of here. Use the launcher.

back.Text: You came back! How did my weapon do?

Text: I saw the explosions from here - Good stuff! I think I might have come up with a real winner this time around. Anyway, since the weapon's registered to my ID, the ICC sent over the bounty reward soon as the kills got registered. Thank you for your help!

weapons.Text: [stand-in] Not right now. Ask Antonio if you need parts.

full.Text: Your hands are full. Make some room in your inventory first.{close}
